strategy_definitions.adaptive: economics-gated sequential profiling simulated over the recorded profile; charged only for the profiling decisions consumed up to its stopping checkpoint
strategy_definitions.correlation_aware: chain-rule correlation-aware estimator on the full profile
strategy_definitions.correlation_aware_confidence: correlation-aware estimator; reorders only if the bootstrap savings probability reaches the configured confidence level
strategy_definitions.economics_gated: decides before profiling, from a structural savings bound and a prior per-decision cost, whether profiling can pay off within the declared horizon; then reorders only if the predicted forward savings are positive
strategy_definitions.independent: Milestone 2 independence estimator on the full profile
